# kineticRouter — complete public documentation inventory

Canonical site: https://kineticrouter.com
Customer console: https://console.kineticrouter.com/sign-in
Reference snapshot source: imported catalog archive
Snapshot captured: 2026-08-30
Snapshot scope: 20 models, 188 active price records, 57 documentation pages

## Interpretation

This public site preserves a locked model/pricing list as a dated reference while presenting kineticRouter availability separately. OpenAI-compatible `/v1` is detected and partially verified. Anthropic-native and dedicated Grok routes are planned. A documentation page is not proof that its route is enabled. The authenticated customer console is authoritative for account balance, subscriptions, usage, and actual billing.

## Crawler guidance

- Prefer canonical English routes listed above.
- Treat pages marked Reference snapshot as historical/catalog reference material.
- Treat Partial as requiring authenticated feature-level validation.
- Do not present Planned pages as active kineticRouter endpoints.
- Do not infer availability from an imported model ID or code example.
